decisions.summary: read only the question fragments and their notes, never the assembled or citations pages
decisions.why: the spec's edge case and Decisions Recorded settle it; the assembled pages repeat the fragments

decisions.summary: a guess item is each sentence of visible (comment-stripped) text carrying GUESS or GUESSES; two labels in one sentence are one item; lower-case guess is not a label
decisions.why: FR-002(a), the comment edge case, SC-001 (one sentence may carry two) and the capitals Assumption

decisions.summary: an absence item is each notes li carrying 'no publicly readable source', shown with its search record and the claim sentence that cites it; 'settled YYYY-MM-DD' makes it absence-settled
decisions.why: FR-002(b) and FR-005; showing the claim serves the suggestion's 'the question'; the settled form is research/CLAUDE.md's ABSENCE form, and an unmatched settled note is still listed, not dropped

decisions.summary: GROUNDS notes and CONVENTION or DEVIATION labels are not items
decisions.why: the spec's edge case names both

decisions.summary: route (a) a class's Entry: resolved by research_questions; route (b) one hop of links from a question a class names
decisions.why: FR-003 and US2 define exactly these two routes; one hop is what 'a question a class names links to it' says

decisions.summary: route (c) matches an engine .py line on the anchor or the heading's question up to its '?', but only when that question is at least 25 characters
decisions.why: FR-003 and US2 route (c) take 'its heading or its anchor' with no length floor; the floor's premise ('a short question cannot match stray text') was not measured, and a grep of l7r/**.py (2026-09-28, this review) finds three question headings under 25 characters ('No interrogation room', 'A castle has TWO gates', 'Drawing a clan border') whose seven engine hits are all genuine citations and none stray - castle_civic.py:186 cites capitals 240 by heading only (the anchor appears nowhere), so the floor drops a real citation and would report 'no map feature found' for a question the map uses the day it carries an open item; no open item is affected today

decisions.summary: make open-questions prints counts first (per page, per kind, outside-the-record by area, totals), then the list, text only, no filters
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-004 and the Assumption that it prints to the terminal

decisions.summary: outside the record: git ls-files under the skill less research/, tests/, the three tooling logs and binaries; each line carrying the whole word GUESS is an item
decisions.why: FR-007 asks for every GUESS label; R3 and D2 establish GUESSES as the plural label, and as written D7's whole-word GUESS misses five labeled lines outside the record (git grep -w GUESSES, 2026-09-28: compound.py:568 and 643, hamletgen/pondstock.py:8 and 25, county-magistracy-example.notes.md:24); the built code (_GUESS = GUESS(?:ES)?) already reads the plural, so this is the plan's text contradicting its own D2 and the spec

decisions.summary: unit tests on a fixture record and one real-record test (homesteads 500 through 505, the compound.py postern, the guess count against a plain count)
decisions.why: FR-006, SC-001, SC-002, SC-004; enforcement of the request

decisions.summary: one pass over the files, one registry import, a whole-text pre-check in the code route
decisions.why: SC-003; a speed mechanism that changes no result
